identity_specification.request_id_source: Explicit payload request_id, or HTTP header X-Request-ID, or auto-generated UUID hex

canonical_input_fingerprint.serialization: canonical JSON (RFC 8785 style sorting, no whitespace)

replay_and_conflict_rules.identical_request_and_completed: Returns cached AgentCycleResponse with status 200 OK (idempotent replay, zero side effects).
replay_and_conflict_rules.identical_request_different_payload: Returns HTTP 409 Conflict ('request_id previously used with different parameters').
replay_and_conflict_rules.active_concurrent_claim: Returns HTTP 409 Conflict ('Agent cycle execution is already running or claimed for request_id').
replay_and_conflict_rules.stale_expected_revision: Returns HTTP 409 Conflict ('State revision conflict: expected X, current Y').
